nodes.name: Normalize and Validate Manage Doctor Schedule

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT $1::TEXT action,$2::TEXT clinic_name,NULLIF($3::BIGINT,0) doctor_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT,'') doctor_name,NULLIF($5::BIGINT,0) schedule_id,
        NULLIF($6::INTEGER,0) weekday,NULLIF($7::TEXT,'')::TIME start_time,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT,'')::TIME end_time,NULLIF($9::TEXT,'')::DATE valid_from,
        NULLIF($10::TEXT,'')::DATE valid_to,NULLIF($11::TEXT,'') actor_name,
        $12::TEXT source_channel
),
context AS (
 SELECT
   c.id AS clinic_id,
   r.clinic_name,
   d.id AS doctor_id,
   d.full_name AS doctor_name,
   r.action,
   r.schedule_id,
   r.weekday,
   r.start_time,
   r.end_time,
   r.valid_from,
   r.valid_to,
   r.actor_name,
   r.source_channel
 FROM r
 JOIN clinics c
   ON c.name=r.clinic_name
 JOIN doctors d
   ON d.clinic_id=c.id
  AND (
        (r.doctor_id IS NOT NULL AND d.id=r.doctor_id)
        OR
        (
          r.doctor_id IS NULL
          AND r.doctor_name IS NOT NULL
          AND d.full_name=r.doctor_name
        )
      )
 LIMIT 1
),
target AS (
 SELECT ds.*
 FROM doctor_schedules ds,context c
 WHERE ds.doctor_id=c.doctor_id
   AND c.schedule_id IS NOT NULL
   AND ds.id=c.schedule_id
 LIMIT 1
),
overlap AS (
 SELECT ds.id
 FROM doctor_schedules ds,context c
 WHERE ds.doctor_id=c.doctor_id
   AND ds.is_active=TRUE
   AND ds.weekday=c.weekday
   AND ds.start_time<c.end_time
   AND ds.end_time>c.start_time
   AND (c.schedule_id IS NULL OR ds.id<>c.schedule_id)
   AND (ds.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_from IS NULL OR ds.valid_to>=c.valid_from)
   AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR ds.valid_from IS NULL OR ds.valid_from<=c.valid_to)
 LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO doctor_schedules(
   doctor_id,weekday,start_time,end_time,is_active,valid_from,valid_to
 )
 SELECT c.doctor_id,c.weekday,c.start_time,c.end_time,TRUE,c.valid_from,c.valid_to
 FROM context c
 WHERE c.action='create' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM overlap)
 RETURNING *
),
updated AS (
 UPDATE doctor_schedules ds
 SET weekday=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.weekday ELSE ds.weekday END,
     start_time=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.start_time ELSE ds.start_time END,
     end_time=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.end_time ELSE ds.end_time END,
     valid_from=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.valid_from ELSE ds.valid_from END,
     valid_to=CASE WHEN c.action='update' THEN c.valid_to ELSE ds.valid_to END,
     is_active=CASE WHEN c.action='activate' THEN TRUE WHEN c.action='deactivate' THEN FALSE ELSE ds.is_active END
 FROM context c
 WHERE ds.id=(SELECT id FROM target)
   AND c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate')
   AND (c.action<>'update' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM overlap))
 RETURNING ds.*
),
effective AS (
 SELECT inserted.* FROM inserted
 UNION ALL SELECT updated.* FROM updated
 UNION ALL SELECT target.* FROM target,context c WHERE c.action='get'
 LIMIT 1
),
admin_event AS (
 INSERT INTO clinic_admin_events(
   clinic_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,actor_name,source_channel,before_data,after_data
 )
 SELECT
   c.clinic_id,'doctor_schedule',
   COALESCE((SELECT id FROM effective),(SELECT id FROM target)),
   c.action,c.actor_name,c.source_channel,
   COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(target) FROM target),'{}'::JSONB),
   COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(effective) FROM effective),'{}'::JSONB)
 FROM context c
 WHERE c.action IN ('create','update','activate','deactivate')
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective)
 RETURNING id
),
listed AS (
 SELECT ds.id,ds.weekday,ds.start_time,ds.end_time,ds.is_active,ds.valid_from,ds.valid_to
 FROM doctor_schedules ds,context c
 WHERE c.action='list' AND ds.doctor_id=c.doctor_id
 ORDER BY ds.weekday,ds.start_time,ds.id
)
SELECT
 CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM context) THEN FALSE
      WHEN c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN FALSE
      WHEN c.action IN ('create','update') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM overlap) THEN FALSE
      ELSE TRUE END success,
 CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM context) THEN 'doctor_not_found'
      WHEN c.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'doctor_schedule_not_found'
      WHEN c.action IN ('create','update') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM overlap) THEN 'doctor_schedule_overlap'
      WHEN c.action='create' THEN 'doctor_schedule_created'
      WHEN c.action='update' THEN 'doctor_schedule_updated'
      WHEN c.action='activate' THEN 'doctor_schedule_activated'
      WHEN c.action='deactivate' THEN 'doctor_schedule_deactivated'
      WHEN c.action='get' THEN 'doctor_schedule_loaded'
      ELSE 'doctor_schedules_listed' END result,
 c.doctor_id,c.doctor_name,
 (SELECT TO_JSONB(effective) FROM effective) doctor_schedule,
 COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) doctor_schedules,
 (SELECT id FROM admin_event) admin_event_id
FROM context c
UNION ALL
SELECT FALSE,'doctor_not_found',NULL::BIGINT,NULL::TEXT,NULL::JSONB,'[]'::JSONB,NULL::BIGINT
FROM r WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM context);
